summary: colinlyguo 提交 EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM，按 Ben Adams 在 ACDE 上的想法把 EIP-7851 与 EIP-8058 的目标合成一个更底层的代码采用原语：当前账户可以采用一个已部署合约的代码。ethresear.ch 上 SPHINCS minus 介绍在 EVM 上高效验证无状态后量子签名。EIP-7904 改为 Informational，因为客户端已在当前 gas 价格下达到 100 Mgas/s 目标，无需计算重定价。Erigon 加入 Encrypt the Mempool Coalition。

items.topic: SETCODEFROM：更底层的代码采用原语
items.title: 新 EIP：SETCODEFROM 代码复用指令
items.note: （colinlyguo）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 22:10，即 EIP-8298。思路来自 ACDE 上 benaadams 的提议，把 EIP-7851 与 EIP-8058 的目标结合：新 EVM 指令让当前账户采用一个已部署合约的 code hash。来源是一个活跃账户地址而非原始 code hash，因此被采用的代码与当前共识状态绑定。两个主要用途：一是部署成本（EIP-8058 的问题），代码相同的合约先初始化各自的存储，再采用共享代码，不必为客户端已存储的字节码重复支付代码存储 gas，在 EIP-8037 让部署更贵后尤其有用；二是停用 ECDSA 的 EOA 迁移（EIP-7851 的问题），迁移代码先初始化钱包状态（包括后量子钱包状态），再采用常规钱包代码，账户有了常规代码后，按 EIP-3607 不能再由 ECDSA 发起交易，也不能再用旧 ECDSA 密钥做 EIP-7702 重新委托。
items.title_en: New EIP: SETCODEFROM Code Reuse Instruction
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 22:10; this is EIP-8298. It comes from benaadams' idea on an ACDE call to combine the goals of EIP-7851 and EIP-8058: a new EVM instruction lets the current account adopt the code hash of an existing deployed contract. The source is a live account address rather than a raw code hash, so the adopted code is tied to the current consensus state. There are two main uses. First, deployment cost (the problem EIP-8058 targets): contracts with identical runtime code initialize their own storage and then adopt shared code without paying code deposit gas again for bytecode clients already store, which matters more once EIP-8037 makes deployment more expensive. Second, EOA migration with ECDSA authority disabled (the problem EIP-7851 targets): migration code initializes wallet state, including post-quantum wallet state, then adopts regular wallet code; once the account has regular code, ECDSA transaction origination is disabled under EIP-3607 and EIP-7702 redelegation through the old ECDSA key is no longer available.
items.topic_en: SETCODEFROM: a lower level code adoption primitive

items.topic: 后量子签名在 EVM 上的验证
items.title: ethresear.ch：SPHINCS minus，在 EVM 上高效验证无状态后量子签名
items.note: 20:15（nicocsgy），致谢 Vitalik、Justin Drake 和 EF PQ 与密码学团队等。文章从量子计算终将破解 ECDSA 出发，讨论基于哈希的无状态签名如何在 EVM 上以可接受的成本验证。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: SPHINCS minus, efficient stateless post-quantum signature verification on the EVM
items.note_en: 20:15 (nicocsgy), with thanks to Vitalik, Justin Drake, the EF PQ and cryptography team and others. Starting from the fact that quantum computers will eventually break ECDSA, it discusses how stateless hash-based signatures can be verified on the EVM at acceptable cost.

items.title: EIP-7904：改为 Informational（不需要计算重定价）
items.note: （misilva73）合并。在 EIP-7928（BAL）优化稳定后重跑 gas 分析，在 100 Mgas/s 目标下，所有被检查的计算操作和预编译在当前 gas 价格下都已达标。EIP 改名为“计算 gas 成本分析”。
items.title_en: EIP-7904: convert to Informational (no compute repricing needed)
items.note_en: (misilva73), merged. The gas analysis was rerun with the EIP-7928 (BAL) optimizations stabilized; at the 100 Mgas/s target, every examined compute operation and precompile clears the target at its current gas cost. The EIP is retitled "Compute Gas Cost Analysis".

summary_en: colinlyguo submitted EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM, which follows Ben Adams' idea from an ACDE call to combine the goals of EIP-7851 and EIP-8058 into a lower level code adoption primitive: the current account can adopt the code of an already deployed contract. SPHINCS minus on ethresear.ch describes efficient verification of stateless post-quantum signatures on the EVM. EIP-7904 was converted to Informational, since clients already reach the 100 Mgas/s target at current gas costs and no compute repricing is needed. Erigon joined the Encrypt the Mempool Coalition.
